subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II artifacts + targeted auth control extracts
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@northbayhealth.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: audits@veritas-audits.com
Date: 2027-03-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II request + narrow control extracts

Hi Grace,

We're onboarding Redwood for an environment review at NorthBay and our security team needs the SOC 2 Type II report for the 2026 audit period. In addition to the report, our auditors have requested a small set of supporting artifacts to complete their control testing:

- MFA enforcement and rotation evidence (last 12 months) — preferably slices around Nov 2026 and Feb 2027.
- A sample of authentication/access logs showing successful/failed MFA challenges (redacted).
- The most recent access review/recertification for privileged groups.
- Signed bridge letter if the report period doesn't cover the full window our auditors need.

Can you confirm what you can provide and an estimated delivery date? We are trying to close our uplift by the end of March. If there are any NDAs or evidence-sharing steps you require, please flag them.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Senior InfoSec Manager | NorthBay Health
elena.ruiz@northbayhealth.com

Attachments: none
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@northbayhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-10T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request + narrow control extracts

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II (2026) plus targeted control artifacts, but a few scope details so we can prepare an appropriate delivery package:  

1) Audit period: our Type II covers 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31. If your auditors need activity into early 2027 we will provide a bridge letter and targeted log slices (as requested).
2) MFA logs: we can deliver redacted slices for Nov 2026 and Feb 2027. We will tokenise usernames and include timestamps, event types (challenge/response), and outcome.
3) Access review: we will attach the Q4 2026 privileged access recertification report and a short summary of remediation items.
4) Delivery: proposed plan below — please confirm you are happy with the scope and redaction approach.

Proposed timeline:
- Today (Mar 10): confirm scope and any specific date ranges you require beyond Nov/Feb.
- Mar 12: we will share a secure DocuSign link for an evidence-sharing attestation (if required) and a preview list of artifacts.
- Mar 17: deliver a secure bundle (PDF + encrypted archive with log slice).

I'll loop in Karthis (security) and Laura (compliance) to validate technical feasibility and redaction. If you need a different cadence to match your audit calendar, tell us and we'll adjust.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com

--
Grace O'Connor
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-10T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request + narrow control extracts

Grace / Laura — quick update from security ops on artifact readiness: 

- SOC 2 Type II (2026) PDF: ready to share (redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf).
- MFA slices: we can produce a TAR with CSV and minimal logs for specific dates. We'll include: event_ts, anonymized_user_id, challenge_type, rpc_result (success/fail), auth_method. Slices for 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-20 and 2027-02-01 to 2027-02-10 are small and fast to extract.
- Access review: the Q4 2026 recertification export is available (access_review_report_Q4_2026.pdf) and an accompanying remediation summary.
- Bridge letter: compliance is prepared to issue a targeted bridge letter that explicitly states the Type II period and items covered; we will attach a signed copy (bridge_letter_signed.pdf).

Redaction and control: we will pseudonymize user identifiers and remove IP addresses; if NorthBay needs full data under an executed DPA/NDA, we will route to legal. For now, the pseudonymized slices should satisfy typical auditor sampling.

Technical ask: do you need the logs in CSV only or do you require raw JSON lines? CSV preferred for the auditors we've worked with, but we can provide either. Also confirm the delivery vault you prefer (Secure S3 link or encrypted DocuSign bundle).

Karthik
Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Attachments: none

Date: 2027-03-11T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request + narrow control extracts

Elena / Veritas team — following up with confirmed plan and delivery items. We will provide the following bundle by end of day Mar 17 (secure link / password-protected archive):

- redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (official report)
- bridge_letter_signed.pdf (explicitly covers Jan 1 — Dec 31 2026 and states availability of targeted log slices into Feb 2027)
- auth_log_slice_202611.tar.gz (includes CSV extract for 2026-11-10 through 2026-11-20, pseudonymized)
- auth_log_slice_202702.tar.gz (includes CSV extract for 2027-02-01 through 2027-02-10, pseudonymized)
- access_review_report_Q4_2026.pdf + remediation_summary.txt

Delivery & access: we will send a Secure S3 link (pre-signed, limited to 7 days) and a DocuSign attestation that covers permitted use and handling. Link will be sent via separate email from compliance@redwood.com.

A couple of clarifications please:
- Format: we will default to CSV extracts unless you request JSONL.
- Redaction: usernames will be pseudonymized; if Veritas requires re-identification under an executed data transfer agreement, we can escalate to legal.

If that scope meets your audit needs, confirm and we'll proceed. Thanks — we aim to keep this lightweight for your auditors.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com
